notes.title: Update Note 11-17-23: Changed Achievement Triggers
notes.content: The achievement triggers have been changed because there is a difference between how certain gaming mechanics manifest between different platforms (i.e. Epic versus Steam) and how they are coded (i.e. an overlap event trigger versus manually triggering an event).
